items.title: What does it mean for the AI trade that Apple is the priciest 'Mag 7' stock?
items.summary: Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on whether Apple is getting too expensive at about 36 times forward earnings and what signals lie beneath it about the AI trade's staying power. Today's panel includes Paisley Nardini, Chief Investment Strategist at Tema ETFs; David Wagner, Head of Equity and Portfolio Manager at Aptus Capital Advisors; Dan DeFrancesco, Executive Editor and anchor of Business Insider Today; and Barron's reporter Nate Wolf.

items.title: Nebius Group (NBIS) Unveils Live GPU Pricing And Builder Grants In Europe

items.title: Why Is Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Backing A $6 Billion AI Assistant Startup?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) is backing a new US$6b AI startup called Hark focused on AI-native assistants. Nvidia and several other industry partners are co-investing in Hark to build integrated hardware and software for AI agents. Hark plans to design chips, system software and tools tailored for advanced personal assistants rather than general-purpose computing.
